title: Hawas Reina EDP 100ml for Women
description:
Hawas Reina is a oriental vanilla fragrance from Rasasi's Hawas line, opening with apricot, pear, and cinnamon. The heart brings in jasmine, frangipani, orange blossom, coconut, and coffee, before settling into a base of vanilla, white musk, amber, sandalwood, and sugar. It's a lush, indulgent fruity-floral gourmand — sweet without being cloying, thanks to the coffee accent cutting through the vanilla and sugar. Best suited to evenings and cooler weather where its warmth and sillage can shine.

As an Eau de Parfum, expect solid projection and long-lasting wear.

100ml Eau de Parfum.

description:
